strategic_horizon.terminal_goal: Build a personal-use weak-network VPN for OpenWrt/Linux ↔ Linux or Windows with UDP/datagram-like earliest-complete inner delivery over WBD-owned TCP-shaped FakeTCP, a conservative release operating point on a physical link at or below 100 Mbit/s, shared username/password admission for multiple independent LiveID sessions, OpenWrt TPROXY capture, and Windows TUN/Wintun-class capture.
strategic_horizon.current_milestone: V2.2 transport/session semantics are protocol-frozen at the qualified 40 Mbit/s aggregate-inner operating point. The first OpenWrt platform slice is now qualified: real Linux nft TPROXY UDP capture, original-destination recovery, WBDP UDP flow mapping, transparent-source reply, underlay escape and cleanup all pass in a root network namespace. This platform-only gate deliberately bypasses FakeTCP/DTLS/LINK and is not the final release one-shot. The next missing platform slice is transparent TCP with adapter-owned stream reliability above the frozen datagram WBD link, followed by one actual OpenWrt front+FakeTCP+DTLS+LINK DNS/TCP/UDP one-shot and then Windows TUN/Wintun-class integration.
strategic_horizon.local_optimization_stop_rule: Do not reopen FEC, FakeTCP, DTLS, Reality-front, ticket/LiveID, association fan-out or one-lane semantics for platform convenience. Preserve earliest-complete WBD datagram delivery. TCP application reliability belongs only to the platform TCP adapter through WBDP offsets/ACKs and must not turn the public FakeTCP carrier into an ordinary ordered kernel-TCP payload stream.

Added internal/platformproxy UDP client flow state keyed by intercepted client endpoint plus original remote peer, stable nonzero FlowIDs, reverse peer pinning and idle expiry; Linux IP_TRANSPARENT/IP_RECVORIGDSTADDR plus IPv6 equivalents; cmd/wbd-platform-proxy-openwrt with IPv4/IPv6 TPROXY sockets and transparent-source reverse sockets reused per remote peer; deterministic flow/sockaddr tests; scripts/openwrt_udp_tproxy_netns.sh; and the openwrt-udp-tproxy Actions gate. GitHub Actions openwrt-udp-tproxy run 32926551954 completed SUCCESS and logged WBD_OPENWRT_UDP_TPROXY_CAPTURE_PASS, WBD_OPENWRT_UDP_UNDERLAY_ESCAPE_PASS and WBD_OPENWRT_UDP_CLEANUP_PASS. Repository ci run 32926551853 also completed SUCCESS with Go tests and Handoff tests. continuation_cursor.current_task: Implement transparent TCP for OpenWrt above internal/platformproxy without changing the frozen WBD transport. The adapter must accept TPROXY TCP connections, recover the original destination, map each intercepted connection to a FlowID, carry TCPOpen/TCPData/TCPAck/TCPClose WBDP frames through the existing local wbd-link-proxy datagram interface, and provide the ordered reliable byte-stream semantics expected by the local TCP application entirely at the platform adapter layer.
continuation_cursor.why_now: The UDP platform gate is clean and the constitution requires real DNS, TCP and UDP before the OpenWrt release one-shot can close. WBDP already reserves TCP open/data/cumulative-ack/close frames with byte offsets, while ADR-0010 forbids solving TCP application reliability by altering FakeTCP/FEC/DTLS/session semantics. Therefore the next work is a bounded adapter reliability state machine, not transport retuning.
continuation_cursor.done_when: Client and server platform adapters support one or more independent transparent TCP flows with no cross-flow or cross-LiveID routing: TCPOpen establishes the server egress connection; TCPData may arrive out of order and is reassembled by byte offset; cumulative TCPAck advances sender state; unacked chunks retransmit on a bounded timer without blocking unrelated flows; half/full close has an explicit tested rule; server state remains keyed by (wbd-link-server-mux service peer, FlowID). Non-root tests cover reassembly/ACK/retransmit/close and flow isolation. A Linux root/netns gate proves real intercepted TCP request/response through TPROXY with underlay escape and cleanup. After that, run one actual OpenWrt front+FakeTCP+DTLS+LINK one-shot carrying real DNS/TCP/UDP before moving to Windows.
continuation_cursor.next_atomic_action: Add a transport-agnostic TCP flow/reliability state machine under internal/platformproxy before wiring sockets. Use the existing WBDP TCPOpen/TCPData/TCPAck/TCPClose contract: fixed-size chunks no larger than MaxPayload, monotonically increasing byte offsets, out-of-order receive buffering, contiguous delivery with cumulative next-byte ACK, a small bounded in-flight window, retransmission of only unacked chunks on timeout, and per-flow close state. Keep flows independent so loss on one intercepted TCP connection cannot block another. Unit-test duplicate/out-of-order DATA, cumulative ACK advancement, timeout retransmission, FIN/close behavior and independent FlowIDs. Only after that state machine is clean, wire Linux TPROXY TCP accept/original-destination and server egress sockets. Do not change linkdata/FEC/FakeTCP/DTLS/Reality/ticket/LiveID/session semantics.

udp_like_status.outer_semantics: WBD-owned TCP-shaped raw carrier with legacy shadow recovery remains frozen. Complete independent inner datagrams never wait for ordinary kernel TCP ordered delivery. Platform TCP stream reliability must remain above WBDP and outside FakeTCP/FEC.
udp_like_status.fec_status: Release path remains FEC off or fixed systematic 20:20 tail-RS; no runtime config epoch or platform-driven retune is qualified.

udp_like_status.memory_policy: Keep bounded independent state per LiveID and per platform flow. Never serialize unrelated flows to save memory.
udp_like_status.capacity_policy: Release qualification remains frozen at 40 Mbit/s aggregate inner on the 100 Mbit/s weak shared-link boundary. Platform work does not reopen capacity exploration.

product_policy.link_setup: Reality-like TLS front is setup/admission only; sustained payload remains FakeTCP -> DTLS -> immutable WBD link data.
product_policy.fec: Association setup admits off or fixed systematic 20:20 on the current live codec. No platform-triggered in-place FEC changes.
product_policy.accounts: One shared username/password may authenticate multiple simultaneous devices; routing/FEC/platform service state remains LiveID/peer/FlowID isolated, never username keyed.
product_policy.recovery: FakeTCP product default remains legacy shadow recovery; sack-rack remains experimental.
product_policy.routing: OpenWrt final capture is TPROXY plus policy routing and mandatory underlay escape. UDP platform capture/return is qualified; transparent TCP is next. Windows final capture remains TUN/Wintun-class with endpoint escape.
product_policy.release_gate: Protocol is frozen by ADR-0010. Remaining release gates are transparent TCP platform qualification, one actual clean OpenWrt TPROXY -> front/FakeTCP/DTLS/LINK -> real DNS/TCP/UDP -> cleanup success, then one clean Windows TUN/Wintun-class one-shot.
